description: Configuration Command Execution and Result Status code set as printed by CMIS 5.4 Table 8-101 (p. 244). CmisConfigStatus keeps the pre-5.4 window, where code 8h is Reserved (other validation failures); CMIS 5.4 allocates 8h to ConfigRejectedNoEmulation, the DP Emulation rejection code added with the Network Path errata incorporation (CMIS 5.4 revision history M1/M2, § 7.6.9.3: a module that does not support DP Emulation of a nominal NP Application shall reject the DP configuration and report "preferably, ConfigRejectedNoEmulation" in ConfigStatusLane<i>). Revision-blind duplicate/overlap rules forbid re-covering the 8h-Bh span in place, so the since-5.4 code set lands here, following the CmisBanksSupported5p4 / CmisVdmObservableType5p4 precedent (ADV-01).

oneOf.description: ConfigUndefined — no status information available (initial register value)
oneOf.title: config_undefined

oneOf.description: ConfigSuccess — the last accepted configuration command has been completed successfully
oneOf.title: config_success

oneOf.title: config_rejected

oneOf.description: ConfigRejectedInvalidAppSel — configuration rejected, invalid AppSel code
oneOf.title: config_rejected_invalid_app_sel

oneOf.description: ConfigRejectedInvalidDataPath — configuration rejected, invalid set of lanes for AppSel
oneOf.title: config_rejected_invalid_data_path

oneOf.description: ConfigRejectedInvalidSI — configuration rejected, invalid SI control settings
oneOf.title: config_rejected_invalid_si

oneOf.description: ConfigRejectedLanesInUse — configuration rejected, some lanes not in DPDeactivated
oneOf.title: config_rejected_lanes_in_use

oneOf.description: ConfigRejectedPartialDataPath — configuration rejected, lanes are only a subset of the Data Path
oneOf.title: config_rejected_partial_data_path

oneOf.description: ConfigRejectedNoEmulation — configuration rejected: DataPath emulation not supported (see section 7.6.9 for a description of DP Emulation)
oneOf.title: config_rejected_no_emulation

oneOf.description: ConfigInProgress — a configuration command is still being processed by the module; new commands are ignored for this lane while ConfigInProgress
oneOf.title: config_in_progress
